jobs.title: Analyst, Project Finance
jobs.desc:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 
 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
 Purpose of role: 
 MUFG Bank, Ltd. is seeking a dedicated Analyst, Project Finance to join their Asian Investment Banking Division in Singapore. This role offers an exceptional platform for growth, learning, and development in project finance, where your contributions will directly support sustainable growth and shared success.
• Join MUFG Bank, Ltd., Japan’s premier bank with a global presence in over 50 markets, offering unparalleled opportunities for collaboration and professional growth.
• Work closely with senior team members on high-profile project finance transactions, gaining hands-on experience in origination, execution, and client engagement.
• Benefit from MUFG’s supportive leadership and inclusive culture, which prioritises training opportunities, inter-personal connections, and shared success across its extensive international network.
 What you'll do: 
 As an Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in supporting senior team members throughout the lifecycle of project finance transactions. • Assist senior team members in the marketing and deal execution of project finance transactions by preparing comprehensive marketing materials, proposals, and presentation packages tailored to client needs.
• Support the origination of lending and financial advisory mandates through diligent research and preparation of relevant documentation required for successful client engagement.
• Contribute to the execution of lending and financial advisory transactions by developing robust financial models, drafting information memorandums, credit papers, and conducting thorough reviews and analyses of project documents.
• Coordinate effectively with specialist advisors and consultants to ensure seamless transaction processes and accurate delivery of advisory services.
• Work collaboratively with MUFG clients as well as various departments across the region and globally to facilitate smooth communication and efficient workflow throughout each stage of the deal process.
• Liaise closely with clients during both origination and execution phases of transactions, ensuring all administrative duties are performed accurately and responsively as required.
• Maintain strict compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements throughout the entire deal process to uphold MUFG’s standards of integrity and trust.

jobs.desc:
Job Description 
 Join ING, a global financial institution renowned for its dynamic and innovative culture and become part of our Capital Markets & Advisory (CMA) division through our 3-6 month Internship Program! This program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in one of four key departments: Corporate Finance/M&A, Debt Capital Markets, Loan Sales or Corporate Investments. 
 As an Intern at ING, you will be directly involved in key initiatives and the execution of live deals, providing you with invaluable insights and practical skills. This is a fantastic chance to immerse yourself in the fast-paced world of capital markets, working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to significant financial transactions. 
 Take this opportunity to develop your expertise and make a meaningful impact at ING! 
 Please make sure you review each team overview below to understand what they do. Then when applying, put your choices in an order with your top priority. By doing this, we can make sure your application is seen by the relevant teams. 
 Corporate Finance / M&A 
 Join ING Corporate Finance, a leading Belgian Corporate Finance house, and become part of a dynamic team of around 15 professional advisors. Under the guidance of a senior advisor, you will engage with key decision-makers at a wide range of medium and large companies, financial sponsors, and other external advisors, including law firms, auditors, and other corporate finance houses. 
 In this role, you will assist in preparing and participating in pitches to potential clients. This involves drafting tailored pitches, conducting in-depth industry analysis, reviewing company strategies and financials, and crafting strategic recommendations that could influence clients' investment or disposal decisions. You will also gather and analyse data on potential acquisition opportunities, assessing their feasibility. Fluency in English and Dutch, both written and spoken, is essential . 
 Throughout the Corporate Finance process, you will support clients at every step. This includes participating in various transaction stages such as data room preparation, coordination, due diligence, and legal documentation follow-up. You will assist in drafting transaction documents like process letters, information memoranda, and valuation reports. Additionally, you will coordinate collaboration between clients, potential investors, and other external advisors. Your role will also involve preparing documentation for and coordinating Equity Capital Markets transactions. 
 This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills and make a significant impact in the world of Corporate Finance and M&A. 
 Debt Capital Markets 
 Explore the world of ING Debt Capital Markets transactions and origination, and develop expertise in various bond structures, pricing, the primary and secondary markets, transaction execution, interest rates, swaps, and other money market instruments. 
 In this role, you will be involved in deal execution for bond refinancings, liability management and sustainable bond market considerations. This includes preparing investor presentations to shape clients' credit stories, structuring deal terms, guiding on bond documentation, and liaising with clients, lawyers, and other banks. You will advise clients and pitch bond transactions, always framing ING's advice within the context of clients' broader capital structures.

jobs.location: BBVA, One Canada Square (44th Floor), Canary Wharf London, E14 5AA (UK)
jobs.desc:
Excited to grow your career? 
 BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.
 The Debt Capital Markets Corporates team is responsible for the origination, structuring and execution of bond financing solutions for corporate clients.
 The team advises clients on their funding strategies, providing access to international debt capital markets through bond issuances and tailored financing solutions.
 Working closely with Corporate Bankers, Syndicate, Trading, Sales, Structuring, Research and Legal teams, DCM Corporates supports clients throughout the transaction lifecycle, from identifying financing opportunities and assessing market conditions to pricing and execution.
 About the job: 
 Key Responsibilities 
• Analyse corporate clients' funding needs and identify bond financing opportunities alongside Corporate Bankers.
• Support the origination, marketing, structuring and execution of corporate bond transactions.
• Prepare DCM pitchbooks, market updates, sector analyses, peer comparables and financing proposals.
• Liaise with the Syndicate desk to obtain indicative bond pricing and provide regular pricing updates to clients.
• Monitor primary and secondary bond markets, maintaining Excel databases covering pricing, recent transactions and corporate peers.
• Participate in client meetings and conference calls, preparing recaps and follow-up materials for senior team members.
• Coordinate with Syndicate, Trading and Structuring teams on transaction pricing and execution.
• Liaise with internal and external Legal teams on bond documentation, including term sheets, prospectuses and transaction agreements, supporting the execution process.
• Leverage BBVA Research insights to identify market opportunities and develop financing ideas for corporate clients.
• Maintain the corporate DCM pipeline and participate in regular commercial reviews with Corporate Bankers.
• Identify and implement AI and automation solutions to streamline pricing updates, market analysis, pitchbook preparation and other recurring DCM processes.
• Support corporate client events, workshops and other commercial initiatives.
 Academic Background 
• Excellent academic credentials.
• University degree, preferably in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Mathematics or another quantitative discipline.
 Previous Experience and Knowledge 
• Previous professional experience in Investment Banking, Debt Capital Markets, Syndicate or related areas will be valued.
• Good understanding of fixed income products, corporate finance and debt capital markets.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including financial analysis and preparation of client presentations.
• Knowledge of Bloomberg and financial modelling will be valued.
• Interest in Artificial Intelligence, automation and their application to financial analysis and process optimisation.
 Language Skills 
• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken (C2 proficiency).
• Spanish and other European languages will be valued.
 Skills 
• Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and work effectively

jobs.desc:
Job Description 
This role will give you the opportunity to innovate and maintain new cross-asset market microstructure analytics to assist clients with execution decisions. Develop pre-trade, real-time monitoring and post-trade analytics infrastructure and tools for both internal and external audiences. Engage in product development and parameter optimization of existing and new Algos on both the front-end and the back-end. As well as work with Sales and Trading to prepare tailored pitches and speak to clients who execute Algos.
 Divisional Overview 
Goldman Sachs’ Strat business unit is a world leader in developing quantitative and technological techniques to solve complex business problems. Working within the firm’s trading, sales, banking and investment management divisions, Strats use their mathematical and scientific training to create financial products, advise clients on transactions, measure risk, and identify market opportunities.
 Job Summary & Responsibilities 
• Innovate and maintain new cross-asset market microstructure analytics to assist clients with execution decisions 
• Develop pre-trade, real-time monitoring and post-trade analytics infrastructure and tools for both internal and external audiences 
• Product Development and parameter optimization of existing and new Algos on both the front-end and the back-end 
• Work with Sales and Trading to prepare tailored pitches and speak to clients who execute Algos 
• Conduct execution strategy analysis, and present these results to both internal and external audiences 
• Regularly interact with clients to provide them with Execution Analysis and Market Color to help them optimize their use of Algos 
• Work with 3rd party vendors to distribute Algo products and analytics via those channels 
 Basic Qualifications 
Successful members of our team hold Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral degrees in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) discipline. We are interested in bright individuals who have strong mathematical and computational backgrounds, and who possess skills in the following areas:
• Bachelors, Masters, or PhD 
• Fluency in Python, some background in database languages such as KDB or SQL 
• A passion for technology, a good understanding of the architecture of complex technological systems and an interest in developing technical solutions to empower/scale the business 
• Project management skills to coordinate Quant and Tech development and timelines 
• Good interpersonal and communication skills, as the role requires the ability to break down a technical conversation to a non-technical person and vice-versa 
• Self-motivated and an inquisitive nature to study any open problem in the electronic space using both a top down and bottom up approach 
 Preferred Qualifications 
• Familiarity with FX, Rates or Futures markets and market structure 
• Some knowledge of Java 
 Salary Range 
The expected base salary for this New York, NY, United States-based position is $110000-$125000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. Job Description 
 What is the opportunity? 
 RBC Capital Markets is a global investment bank providing services in banking, finance, and capital markets to corporations, institutional investors, asset managers, and governments globally. Our Equity-Linked Capital Markets Origination team structures and executes innovative equity-linked solutions, including convertible bonds, equity derivatives, and other hybrid securities, to meet clients' complex financing and strategic needs.
 We are seeking a highly motivated Investment Banking Analyst to join our Equity-Linked Capital Markets Origination team. This role offers unparalleled exposure to structuring and executing equity-linked transactions, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and engaging directly with clients. The candidate will develop expertise in financial modeling, transaction execution, and market analysis while contributing to RBC’s leadership in the equity-linked space.
 What will you do? 
 § Support senior bankers in structuring and executing equity-linked transactions (e.g., convertible bonds, mandatory convertibles, exchangeable notes, equity derivatives)
 § Build and maintain complex financial models to evaluate transaction structures, pricing, and scenarios
 § Prepare client presentations, pitch books, and marketing materials to articulate RBC’s equity-linked solutions
 § Conduct market research and analysis of industry trends, including tax, accounting, and regulatory developments
 § Coordinate with internal teams (e.g., IB coverage, Legal, Risk, Trading, Syndicate) to ensure seamless transaction execution
 § Monitor post-issuance performance of equity-linked securities and provide updates to clients and stakeholders
 § Participate in client meetings, leveraging technical expertise to build relationships and drive business development
 What do you need to success? 
 § Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline
 § 0-4 years of experience in investment banking, equity capital markets, or a related field (e.g., structured products, derivatives)
 § Strong proficiency in financial modeling (Excel), accounting, and valuation techniques
 § Familiarity with equity-linked instruments a plus, but not a requirement
 § Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills
 § Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment
 § Excellent communication and presentation skills
 § Team-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality client service
 What’s in it for you? 
 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. What We Do 
As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

About Alantra 
 Alantra is an independent global financial services firm that provides investment banking and asset management services to midmarket companies, families, and investors. The Group has over 500 professionals in Europe, the U.S., Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. 
 In Investment Banking, Alantra has completed over 1,000 transactions in the last five years. Alantra combines a strong local presence in key financial centers with global sector- and product-specialized teams. 
 In Alternative Asset Management, Alantra offers its clients unique access to a wide range of investment strategies in five highly specialized asset management classes (private equity, active funds, private debt, energy, and venture capital). As of 31 December 2025, assets under management from consolidated businesses stood at c. €2.7bn, while those managed by firms in which the Group holds a strategic stake amounted to c €14.5bn
 Job Description:

 We seek to hire a Corporate Finance / M&A Intern to support the very strong deal flow of our Swiss team based in Zurich (as of July 2027 for a duration of 6 months). 
We offer a highly entrepreneurial and inspiring environment, with a collaborative and friendly approach, and the opportunity to learn from seasoned deal makers with direct involvement in all phases of a transaction. Interns displaying high aptitude and performance may be offered a full time Analyst position.

Your responsibilities include data gathering, in-depth company and industry research, financial analysis and valuations and supporting business documentation preparation.

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 
 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 CIBC Capital Markets provides corporate, government, and institutional clients with innovative solutions to help them raise capital, and grow and invest actively throughout North America, Latin America, and key financial centres around the world. Our mission is to bring Canadian Capital Markets products to Canada and the rest of the world, and also bring the world to Canada.
 CIBC Capital Markets Mergers & Acquisitions group of professionals are dedicated specifically to advising clients on mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, hostile takeovers, buyouts, takeover defense and restructurings. There is an extensive amount of interaction with other groups within the firm in order to provide clients with customized financing and advisory solutions. 
 As part of the M&A group, you will be expected to provide a broad range of analytical, research and presentation preparation support to all the professionals as well as gaining exposure to working with individuals from various groups across the firm. A team approach to executing coverage and financing assignments is designed to provide progressive, on-the-job training. The role of an Analyst within CIBC’s Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Investment Banking group is challenging and fast-paced. It requires dedication, a passion for excellence, and an exceptional work ethic.
 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. To successfully perform the work, you'll be on-site full-time. 
 The expected annualized base salary for this role is $105,000.
The base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, as well as geographic location and specific business needs. Our compensation philosophy supports ongoing growth and development, enabling progression within the salary range as team members advance in their roles.
In addition to base pay, compensation for this role includes participation in an annual discretionary incentive or bonus program.
We are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation opportunities for all employees and we encourage open conversations about compensation throughout the recruitment process.
 How You’ll Succeed 
• Client Proposals - Assist in analyzing and developing proposals for mergers, asset or company divestitures or acquisitions, and other financial products and advisory services
• Transaction Execution – Take an active role in day-to-day transaction execution across sell-side, buy-side, fairness opinions, and other assignments
• Financial Modeling - Develop and audit sophisticated financial models
• Collaboration - Participate in cross-functional teams and liaise with other units of CIBC Capital Markets in executing mandates or preparing proposals for clients
• Research - Prepare industry and financial analysis to determine client recommendations
• Analysis - Lead industry comparables and precedent transaction analyses
• Due Diligence - Assist in company due diligence investigations
• Marketing

jobs.desc:
About General Atlantic 
 General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com. 
 Position Summary 
 General Atlantic is looking to hire an entrepreneurial-spirited Analyst to support the China Investment team in Shanghai.
 This role will have exposure to all parts of the investment process, from sourcing investment opportunities, to conducting initial diligence and presenting to the Investment Committee, as well as supporting the value creation initiatives in GA’s portfolio, playing an important role in the firm’s growth and success.
 Responsibilities 
• Building financial models and performing various financial analysis to support investment due diligence and portfolio value creation
• Drafting investment memoranda and presentation to present to General Atlantic’s investment committee
• Working with Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and management teams to support portfolio companies
• Assisting in research and identification of investment themes and potential targets through in-depth industry research
• Perform deep proprietary research through calls with industry contacts, consultants, and other relevant parties
 Qualifications 
• Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Business, Accounting or related field
• 1-2 years of relevant experience strongly preferred (e.g. Investment Banking, Private Equity and Venture Capital preferred. Consulting or Operations in addition to Investment Banking will also be considered.)
• Verbal and written fluency in Mandarin and English required
• Passionate about discovering interesting transformational up-and-coming high-growth companies
• Strong understanding of accounting principles
• Superior financial modeling skills (ability to create and manipulate complex financial models with minimum guidance)
• Proficient with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
• Strong analytical abilities, creativity, thoughtful business judgment and professional maturity
• Record of outstanding professional and academic achievement
• Desire to collaborate with colleagues throughout the firm globally
• Demonstrated maturity and professional presence, comfortable interacting with senior executives
 GA Value 
• Competitive compensation
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans
• Retirement savings plan with employer matching
• Professional development opportunities and ongoing training
• Collaborative and inclusive work

jobs.title: Stagiaire Analyste Financement de Projets EnR - H/F
jobs.desc:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS 
 Créée fin 2009, CVE est un producteur français d'énergies renouvelables qui développe, finance, construit et exploite des centrales photovoltaïques et des unités de méthanisation .
 Entreprise à mission et labellisée B Corp, notre raison d’être est portée par nos équipes : « mettre l’humain et la planète au cœur des énergies de demain » .
 Aujourd'hui, CVE compte plus de 450 collaborateurs (dont 350 en France) répartis entre les missions commerciales, techniques (ingénierie, construction, exploitation), administratives et financières et tous engagés dans une aventure entrepreneuriale unique au service de la transition énergétique. En plaçant l’humain au cœur de son projet, CVE a forgé sa culture d'entreprise autour de 3 piliers : l'épanouissement individuel et collectif, l'engagement et l'excellence .
 CVE a pour ambition de bâtir, d'ici 2027, un parc d’une puissance de 2,4 GW et de devenir un acteur de référence des énergies renouvelables en circuit court au service des entreprises et territoires.
 http://www.cvegroup.com/ 
 LES MISSIONS QUE NOUS VOUS PROPOSONS 
 Rattaché.e à un Responsable de Financement, vous aurez la responsabilité d’accompagner l'équipe Financement de Projets dans la mise en œuvre des financements de l’ensemble des projets d’infrastructures d’énergies renouvelables financés par le groupe CVE sur le territoire national et à l’international (Chili, USA, Afrique du Sud, Espagne).
 A ce titre, vos missions pourront être les suivantes :
• Participation à l’ élaboration et la revue détaillée des Business Plans de projets :
• Modélisation financière ;
• Accompagnement des équipes du contrôle de gestion sur les prévisions de trésorerie associée aux levées de financements, prévision des performances opérationnelles futures (flux de trésorerie, besoins en fonds de roulement, etc.).
• Préparation des dossiers de financements à l’attention des banques, fonds d’investissement et tout autre partenaire financier, juridique et technique.
• Suivi des audits réalisés par les bureaux d’études et conseils externes du Groupe CVE.
• Administration des Data Room des projets et participation à l’ amélioration des process de compilations et d’échanges de données entre les différents services du Groupe et à destination des partenaires et conseils.
• Possible collaboration avec l’équipe M&A pour la mise en place de financement d’acquisitions (Bridge Financing and Acquisition Financing).
• Assistance de l’équipe Financement Middle Office pour la réalisation des reportings auprès des partenaires.
• Assistance de l’équipe Financement Valo & Invest pour la mise à jour de simulateurs et du modèle Groupe .
 En fonction de la période et des projets en cours, vous pourrez intervenir sur une ou différente.s zone.s d’exposition du Groupe CVE : France (Photovoltaïque, Méthanisation) et international (Chili et Etats-Unis).
 LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS 
 En cours de formation supérieure (Bac +5) avec une spécialisation en finance, vous souhaitez participer à des transactions complexes à forte dimension financière dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables en France et à l’international.
 Vous avez une parfaite compréhension des états financiers (compte de résultats, bilan, etc.) et vous maîtrisez parfaitement les outils informatiques et notamment Excel . Vous disposez idéalement d’une première expérience en modélisation financière. 
 Vous maîtrisez l’anglais . La maitrise de l’espagnol est un plus.
 Vous êtes doté.e d’un esprit d’ini

jobs.title: Banking, Investment Banking – Healthcare, Placement Analyst, London – United Kingdom 2027
jobs.desc:
Citi is looking for placement analysts to join the Investment Banking Healthcare team in London, from February 2027.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed: 
 We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. During our 3-6 month placement analyst program, which starts in February 2027, you will be assigned to the IB Healthcare team. Successful placement analysts will be considered for a full time position after graduation.
 Your time here will look something like this: 
• Keeping up to date on the latest news, developments and trends that are driving equity markets by using the intelligence of Citi’s global equities platform, communicating that information to your clients.
• Develop an understanding of how companies are viewed and valued by institutional investors through speaking to some of the most important mutual fund and hedge fund managers.
• Build financial models, assess valuation, and explore transaction opportunities for your clients
• Conduct research and analyse industry trends.
• Help to strengthen your clients’ shareholder base by conducting analysis on potential new investors.
• Participate in client development by having an active role in building new and existing client relationships, and assisting in the presentation of new ideas to clients.
 We want to hear from you if: 
• You are studying for a degree that allows for a 3-6-month industrial placement or have graduated.
• Expected to achieve or have achieved a 2:1 (or equivalent) at undergraduate level in any degree discipline.
• You have an interest in business.
• You are available to start in February 2027.
 Who we think will be a great fit: 
 We’re looking for motivated individuals, who are eager to grow their careers in Investment Banking. Successful candidates take pride in all aspects of their work and recognize that it is a reflection not just of the firm, but of themselves. We value diversity and so do you. We’ll also be looking for the following:
• Commitment to personal growth and career development including mobility and flexibility. You also have a strong desire to learn, are proactive, building rapport and relationships in team environments.
• Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.
• Intellectual curiosity and proactive approach to searching for new and creative ideas.
• Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills.
• Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making.
• Interest in business.
 We will be recruiting on a rolling basis therefore we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. There is no deadline for applications.
Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary. The role will be based at 25 Canada Square Canary Wharf - London, E14 5LB, United Kingdom.
The role currently offers a hybrid working model, with a mandatory three days in your assigned office, and an optional two days from home. Citi supports this business model, subject to business approval.

jobs.title: Analyst – Strategic Advisory (Industrials)

PJT Partners is a global advisory-focused investment bank. Our team of senior professionals delivers a wide array of strategic advisory, shareholder advisory, restructuring and special situations and private fund advisory and placement services to corporations, financial sponsors, institutional investors and governments around the world. We offer a unique portfolio of advisory services designed to help our clients achieve their strategic objectives. We also provide, through PJT Park Hill, private fund advisory and fundraising services for alternative investment managers, including private equity funds, real estate funds and hedge funds.
 From the beginning, PJT Partners has firmly believed that having the best people is key to building an enduring franchise. Our perspective was, and remains, that a great team brings in both top tier clients and appeals to a wide-range of diverse, talented colleagues. Fostering an inclusive culture, which welcomes differing perspectives and beliefs, enables us to provide the best advice and insights to our clients.
 To learn more about PJT Partners, please visit our website at www.pjtpartners.com . 
 Responsibilities 
 The Strategic Advisory group is one of the most experienced teams in the industry, and has been involved in some of the largest, most complex transactions in recent years. Our global team focuses on a diverse set of industries, including technology, media & telecommunications, consumer & retail, financials & insurance, energy, oil & gas, power, utilities & renewables, industrials, aerospace & defense, healthcare and real estate, gaming, lodging, and leisure.
 The Industrials Analyst will be a critical member of PJT’s Industrials platform with direct involvement in both deal execution and business development. The team is stable, tight-knit, collaborative and is seeking to add to its talent pool to respond to a sustained increase in deal activity. Industrials Analysts should expect to work on lean deal teams executing complex and intellectually satisfying projects for blue-chip clients.
 We are seeking qualified candidates who possess knowledge and interest in industrials advisory. Analysts would be responsible for the following:
• Financial analysis and modeling
• Drafting of client presentations
• Preparation of memoranda for internal and external use
• Conducting financial and other business related research
• Coordinating complex and time-sensitive processes 
• Active involvement in client facing situations
• Assistance in the execution of transactions
• Participation in talent development efforts, including recruiting
 Qualifications:
 PJT Partners seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligent and have excellent academic, leadership and extracurricular records. In addition, qualified candidates will possess the following:
• 1 – 3 years of experience in a relevant field or experience in a Industrials group at a bulge bracket or boutique advisory firm
• Analytical and detail oriented with strong organizational and problem solving skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Self-motivated and proactive
• Aptitude to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Robust organizational and time management skills
• Strong work ethic and ability to work well under pressure
• Resume must be in PDF format 
 Expected annualized base salary of $120,000 to $150,000.
 This range represents the low and high ends of the expected annualized base salary for this position.

Travailler chez ING Wholesale Banking, c’est rejoindre l’une des trois premières banques de financement et d’investissement étrangères opérant en France, et dans plus de 40 pays. Nous collaborons avec 75% des sociétés du CAC40 (et plus de la moitié des entreprises du SBF 120), des fonds d’investissement de premier ordre et des sociétés privées de taille significative.
 Et parce que nous sommes convaincus que l'avenir exige un engagement durable, nous proposons une large gamme de produits et services pour soutenir activement nos clients dans leurs efforts pour développer un modèle d'entreprise adapté aux défis sociaux et environnementaux d'aujourd'hui. 
 Etudiant(te), jeune diplômé(e) ou professionnel(le) expérimenté(e), en nous rejoignant, tu intégreras une entreprise innovante et responsable. Inclusive et engagée notamment sur l’égalité homme/femme, ING t’offrira de nombreuses opportunités pour développer tes talents tout en restant toi-même. Tu auras l’opportunité d’évoluer au sein d’équipes bienveillantes, à taille humaine et dans un contexte international.
 Alors deviens notre Stagiaire Corporate Sector Coverage H/F
 Role et Responsabilités 
 En tant que stagiaire, tu assisteras le responsable et les membres de l’équipe des chargés d’affaires (Senior Bankers et Relationship Managers) dans l’ensemble de leurs fonctions et notamment :
• La préparation de rendez-vous, la recherche d’informations et l’élaboration de pitch clients
• La mise à jour des dossiers dans le cadre des procédures KYC
• L’interface avec les équipes support de la banque
• Le support aux actions de prospection commerciale
• La rédaction de reporting sur les activités et les revenus du département
 Ce stage, très formateur, sera l’occasion pour toi de bien comprendre la nature des relations entre une banque et une grande entreprise, de te donner une vision précise sur les éléments commerciaux et KYC nécessaires aux prises de décision et une idée précise des grands métiers de la banque d’entreprises (Gestion des Flux, Forex, Trade Finance, Financements spécialisés/projets, Debt Capital Market, Advisory, etc.). • Tu maîtrises Excel (formule complexe, tableau croisé dynamique …)
• Tu sais faire preuve de curiosité, d’ouverture esprit et de proactivité et tu sais gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément
• Tu es force de proposition, tu as le goût du challenge et tu sais évoluer aisément en milieu transversal
 Si tu veux connaitre notre processus de recrutement, n’hésite pas à aller faire un tour ici : https://www.ing.jobs/france/ing-et-vous/recrutement-chez-ing.htm 
 Avantages 
 Et parce que, chez ING, nous pensons que le bien-être de nos collaborateurs ne se limite pas à des missions stimulantes nous proposons :
• Le télétravail est possible pour un juste équilibre entre présence sur site et home office.
• La prise en charge de ton Pass Navigo à 50%

• Un environnement bienveillant et dynamique !

Position Overview 
About Harris Williams
We are a global investment bank specializing in M&A and private capital advisory services. Clients worldwide rely on us to help unlock value in their business and turn ambitious goals into reality. We approach every engagement with boundless collaboration, pooling expertise and relationships across industries, service offerings, and geographies. For over 30 years, our clients have trusted us to think strategically, execute precisely, and deliver premium outcomes to help them grow. 
Harris Williams will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position. 
 Job Description 
 Harris Williams seeks to hire an Analyst to join the Sponsor Coverage team in Richmond, VA. The Sponsor Coverage Analyst develops critical insights and analyses in support of senior Sponsor Coverage bankers and private equity (“PE”) client strategies.
• Meaningful impact from the start: Analyze and manage HW proprietary data analyses, including buyer performance and behavior, valuation trends and observations, process dynamics, pitch activity, etc. and assist in funneling insights to both Sponsor Coverage and HW deal teams in preparation for client meetings
• Diverse projects: Track private equity industry trends and broader macro-economic data to inform HW’s market insights. Leverage Excel and PowerPoint to prepare ad hoc analysis and client-ready materials, including peer comparison analyses, deal history, relationship updates, and qualitative insights in support of client meetings and origination activities.
• Collaborative work environment: Our goal is to unlock value in great businesses, and it starts by unlocking greatness in each other. We value a range of backgrounds and expertise, and we know our work is better when our teams inspire every individual to confidently contribute. In this role, you will collaborate with senior Sponsor Coverage bankers and HW Industry Group bankers to drive highly strategic, targeted, and efficient lead pursuit. You will also partner closely with HW’s data services and technology teams to help optimize and inform development of key reports, as well as ad hoc projects and firm analyses in support of HW firm leadership
• Professional development : Your professional development is our top priority. You will participate in a robust training program designed to build relationships, provide baseline knowledge of M&A, and prepare you for your role in the Sponsor Coverage Group. This initial training is just the beginning of an extensive learning experience.
• Comprehensive compensation and benefits program : Highly competitive compensation, pension, 401(k) matching, and eligibility for performance bonus amongst many other robust benefits.
 What We Look For 
 Harris Williams hires individuals who are motivated by challenge, demonstrated through academic performance combined with involvement outside the classroom, which can include: participation in sports, student led organizations, or work experience while completing a degree. No specific academic major is required; however, the following skillsets are desired: 
 · Excel – Understanding of formulas, data validation, macros, tables, conditional formatting

 Alantra is an independent global financial services firm that provides investment banking and asset management services to midmarket companies, families, and investors. The Group has over 500 professionals in Europe, the U.S., Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. 
 In Investment Banking, Alantra has completed over 1,000 transactions in the last five years. Alantra combines a strong local presence in key financial centers with global sector- and product-specialized teams.

 Job Description:

Intervenant généralement sur des opérations portant sur des valeurs d’entreprise comprises entre 50 et 500 millions d’euros, Alantra exerce principalement deux activités : le conseil en fusions-acquisitions ( M&A Advisory ) et le conseil en financement ( Debt Advisory ).

jobs.title: Investment Banking Off-Cycle Intern
jobs.desc:
About MACA Advisors

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

The program

The MACA Off-Cycle Internship is an 8-week educational program, run outside the summer in three windows each year – Winter (1 December – 15 February), Spring (1 March – 15 May) and Fall (1 September – 15 November), with windows open from Winter 2026–27 through Fall 2028 – and exact dates agreed with each participant, for students who want to understand how cross-border M&A advisory works in practice. It is built around a structured curriculum taught by the firm’s bankers, case work modeled on real transactions, and supervised observation of how our team runs mandates. The program is designed to complement your studies, and we work with universities to support academic credit where it is available.

What you will learn

 - Financial modeling and valuation: comparable companies, precedent transactions and DCF, taught in weekly sessions and applied in case exercises

 - How a sell-side, buy-side or capital raise advisory process runs, from preparation to closing

 - Research methods for companies, sectors and comparable transactions using FactSet, Bloomberg, PitchBook and Capital IQ

 - How professional presentations, teasers and memos are structured and written

 - Latin American M&A specifics, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

How the program works

 - A weekly training curriculum led by the firm’s bankers

 - Case projects built on anonymized or past transactions, with written feedback on each

 - Observation of team meetings and selected client calls, followed by debrief sessions on what was decided and why

 - A designated mentor who reviews your work and meets with you each week

 - A final case presentation to the firm’s partners, with a written evaluation at the close of the program

What you bring

 - Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program in finance, economics, business or a related field, continuing through the window you select

 - An exceptional academic record (minimum GPA of 3.7 or equivalent)

 - Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and of accounting fundamentals

 - Curiosity, care in the details and a willingness to ask questions

 - Fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese required for Brazil-based participants)

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

Preferred

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value – we are a generalist firm

What you take away

 - Practical training in modeling, valuation and transaction process

 - A body of case work you can discuss with confidence

 - A mentor relationship with a working M&A banker

 - A written evaluation and, on request, a reference

 - Participation in the program does not guarantee an offer of employment. Participants who complete it may apply to our Analyst program.

Our process

 - An interview with a partner covering your studies and interests

 - A short case exercise

 - Confirmation with your university of any academic credit or internship agreement

jobs.title: Analyst, Primary
jobs.desc:
Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”) is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $82 billion* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025. 
 Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments. Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.
 The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.
 Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.
 * As of September 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request. 
 The Opportunity 
 This is a rare chance to launch your investment career at the heart of one of the most established primary investment franchises in private markets. As an Analyst on our London Primary Investments Team, you will sit alongside experienced investors evaluating the best private equity and venture capital funds in Europe and beyond – the managers backing the companies shaping the future economy.
 From day one, you will be a genuine member of the deal team: forming a view on managers, interrogating track records, and helping decide where our clients’ capital is committed. You will gain exposure across the full breadth of private markets – buyout, growth, and venture, across geographies and sectors – building the judgement and network that define a long-term career as an investor.
 What You’ll Do 
• Evaluate investment opportunities – assess private equity and venture capital funds, forming a view on manager quality, strategy, and the durability of their edge.
• Dig into the numbers – analyse fund and portfolio performance, track records, value creation, and attribution to understand what truly drives returns.
• Build the investment case – contribute your analysis and conclusions directly to investment memoranda that go in front of our investment committee.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Summer Analyst
jobs.desc:
ABOUT MACA ADVISORS

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

 


THE PROGRAM

The MACA Summer Analyst program is an educational program held each year from early June to the end of July – June 1 to July 30, 2027, and June 1 to July 28, 2028 – for students who want to understand how cross-border M&A advisory works in practice. It is built around a structured curriculum taught by the firm's bankers, case work modeled on real transactions, and supervised observation of how our team runs mandates. The program is designed to complement your studies, and we work with universities to support academic credit where it is available.

 


WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

 - Financial modeling and valuation: comparable companies, precedent transactions and DCF, taught in weekly sessions and applied in case exercises

 - How a sell-side, buy-side or capital raise advisory process runs, from preparation to closing

 - Research methods for companies, sectors and comparable transactions using FactSet, Bloomberg, PitchBook and Capital IQ

 - How professional presentations, teasers and memos are structured and written

 - Latin American M&A specifics, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

 


HOW THE PROGRAM WORKS

 - A weekly training curriculum led by the firm's bankers

 - Case projects built on anonymized or past transactions, with written feedback on each

 - Observation of team meetings and selected client calls, followed by debrief sessions on what was decided and why

 - A designated mentor who reviews your work and meets with you each week

 - A final case presentation to the firm's partners, with a written evaluation at the close of the program

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate program in finance, economics, business or a related field, with expected graduation in 2028 (2027 program) or 2029 (2028 program)

 - An exceptional academic record (minimum GPA of 3.7 or equivalent)

 - Working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Word, and of accounting fundamentals

 - Curiosity, care in the details and a willingness to ask questions

 - Fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese required for Brazil-based participants)

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

 


PREFERRED

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value – we are a generalist firm

 


WHAT YOU TAKE AWAY

 - Practical training in modeling, valuation and transaction process

 - A body of case work you can discuss with confidence

 - A mentor relationship with a working M&A banker

 - A written evaluation and, on request, a reference

 - Participation in the program does not guarantee an offer of employment. Participants who complete it may apply to our Analyst program.

 


OUR PROCESS

 - An interview with a partner covering your studies and interests

 - A short case exercise

 - Confirmation with your university of any academic credit or internship agreement

jobs.desc:
Position Description: Investment Analyst



About Us

Ridgepeak Partners is a private equity firm that partners with founder-operators to build category-leading platforms across durable, essential services industries. Our platforms leverage a high-velocity buy-and-build strategy to drive rapid organic and inorganic growth.



Position Overview

We're hiring an Investment Analyst to serve as a full-cycle deal professional across Ridgepeak's portfolio. Analysts partner with platform leadership and own transactions end to end: from proprietary origination and seller relationship-building through financial modeling, investment memos, offer terms, and diligence to close. Analysts also contribute to sector identification for future platform launches, honing research skills and investment judgment outside of a live deal environment.

This is a high-accountability, high-ownership role for someone who wants exposure to the full deal lifecycle early in their career and is motivated by competitive, measurable results.



Candidate Profile

Our ideal candidate is competitive, resourceful, and comfortable owning outcomes rather than just tasks. Successful candidates may come from backgrounds in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or other deal-intensive roles, though we hire strong analytical thinkers from any background who can show the same rigor and drive.

Regardless of background, candidates should be comfortable both picking up the phone to build a relationship with a business owner and building a financial model that leadership will rely on for a capital allocation decision. This is a demanding, fast-paced environment; we're looking for people who want ownership early and are willing to earn it.



Responsibilities

Deal Sourcing & Pipeline Development

 - Source acquisition targets through direct, proprietary outreach across Ridgepeak's target industries, building a growing pipeline and direct relationships with business owners and prospective sellers.

Financial Analysis & Modeling

 - Analyze target company financial and operational data and build detailed valuation, structuring, and forecasting models that surface key value drivers and risks.

Investment Memos & Offer Preparation

 - Prepare investment memos covering thesis, financial profile, and risks, structure offer terms and LOIs with leadership, and present recommendations concisely.

Due Diligence & Deal Execution

 - Coordinate financial, legal, and operational diligence with counsel, advisors, and internal stakeholders to shepherd transactions from signed LOI through closing.

Market Research

 - Track industry trends and market dynamics across Ridgepeak's target sectors, refine acquisition criteria, and research high-potential markets for future Ridgepeak platforms.
   
   

Qualifications & Personal Attributes

 - Competitive and motivated to win, with a genuine ownership mindset. Takes accountability for outcomes, not just activity.

 - Clear, structured thinker with strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Intellectually curious and analytically rigorous. Comfortable with financial modeling; strong working proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

 - Able to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders, including business owners and company leadership.

 - Organized and detail-oriented under pressure, able to manage multiple live opportunities at once.

 - Evidence of accountability, initiative, and teamwork through athletics, leadership position

jobs.title: V.I.E - Energy & Infrastructure Officer - Milan, H/F
jobs.desc:
V.I.E - Energy & Infrastructure Officer - Milan, H/F 
 BNP Paribas est un groupe bancaire international, présent dans 63 pays et reconnu pour son expertise dans l’accompagnement de ses clients, tant au quotidien que dans leurs projets d’avenir.
 Vous rejoindrez la Banque de Financement et d’Investissement (CIB), au sein de l’équipe Energy, Resources & Infrastructure (E&I) basée à Milan. 
 Cette équipe est en charge du project finance, des financements structurés et des activités de debt advisory pour des projets stratégiques dans les secteurs de l’énergie, des infrastructures et des transitions bas carbone. 
 L’environnement est international, exigeant et stimulant, avec une proximité forte avec les plateformes EMEA de Paris, Londres, Bruxelles et Madrid. 
 Au quotidien, ça donne quoi ? 
 Vous intégrerez l’ Execution Team au sein de la division E&I en tant qu’Analyste V.I.E. 
 Votre rôle sera d’appuyer les équipes sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des transactions de financements structurés et de project finance.
 Concrètement, vous développerez vos compétences en modélisation financière, notamment en réalisant des analyses de flux de trésorerie, du debt sizing, des sensibilités et, lorsque nécessaire, en construisant des modèles financiers complets sous la supervision d’un Associate, d’un VP ou d’un Director. 
 Vous analyserez également les rapports de due diligence et participerez aux échanges techniques et juridiques associés. 
 Vous contribuerez à la préparation des screening memos et des credit papers, aussi bien pour les nouvelles transactions que pour les opérations en portefeuille, tout en soutenant les équipes d’origination dans la préparation de pitchs et dans le suivi des tendances sectorielles et réglementaires. 
 Vous participerez au monitoring des transactions post‑closing, incluant la construction et/ou l’exploitation des projets financés, la production des annual reviews, la mise à jour des modèles bancaires, l’analyse des sensibilités, ainsi que l’accompagnement d’éventuelles opérations de refinancement ou de restructuration. 
 Enfin, vous serez impliqué(e) dans les réunions clients et banques, les interactions internes (risques, conformité, juridique, consulting technique, etc.), ainsi que dans diverses tâches de prévision et de suivi administratif liées aux dossiers de financement. 
 Et après ? 
 Cette expérience constitue une porte d’entrée privilégiée dans le monde du project finance et, plus largement, des financements structurés.
 Elle vous permettra de développer des compétences clés en analyse financière, structuration, évaluation des risques, compréhension des aspects techniques et juridiques, et gestion de transactions complexes. 
 À l’issue de cette mission, vous pourrez envisager une évolution vers :
• des fonctions d’analyste ou d’associate en project finance ou structured finance ;
• des rôles en conseils financiers ou en activités d’investissement chez des sponsors industriels ou fonds spécialisés ;
• des opportunités au sein des plateformes E&I en Europe ou plus largement dans les métiers de la CIB.

jobs.desc:
VIE - Analyst Energy, Resources and Infrastructure - Sydney H/F 
 Présent dans 64 pays et territoires, BNP Paribas est l'un des principaux groupes bancaires internationaux. En Australie et en Nouvelle-Zélande, BNP Paribas accompagne depuis plus d'un siècle les grandes entreprises, investisseurs institutionnels et acteurs économiques grâce à l'expertise de ses activités de Corporate and Institutional Banking et d'Asset Management. 
 Au sein de l'équipe Energy, Resources and Infrastructure (ERI), vous contribuerez au financement de projets stratégiques liés à la transition énergétique, aux infrastructures numériques et au développement des ressources essentielles à l'économie de demain. 
 Au quotidien, ça donne quoi ? 
 En tant que VIE - Analyst Energy, Resources and Infrastructure, vous rejoindrez l'équipe ERI basée à Sydney et participerez au développement des activités de financement et de structuration de transactions dans les secteurs de l'énergie, des infrastructures et des ressources naturelles en Australie et en Nouvelle-Zélande. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international exigeant, au contact d'experts du financement de projet et de grandes entreprises engagées dans la transition énergétique et le développement des infrastructures du futur. 
 Vous serez notamment amené à :
• Réaliser des analyses sectorielles, des études de marché et des travaux de due diligence pour accompagner les équipes dans leurs projets de financement ;
• Participer à l'analyse financière et au suivi du risque de crédit de clients et de transactions existantes ou en développement ;
• Contribuer à la gestion et au suivi d'un portefeuille de financements, notamment à travers la préparation de revues annuelles, d'amendements et de propositions de crédit ;
• Construire, adapter et exploiter des modèles financiers dans le cadre de transactions ou d'analyses stratégiques ;
• Participer à la préparation de présentations commerciales, de supports marketing et d'opérations de prospection auprès des clients, tout en contribuant à l'exécution des mandats de financement et de conseil. 
 Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des directeurs, vice-présidents et autres experts métier, tout en étant exposé à une grande diversité de projets structurants pour les secteurs de l'énergie et des infrastructures. 
 Et après ? 
 Cette mission vous permettra de développer une expertise approfondie en analyse financière, financement structuré, gestion du risque de crédit et modélisation financière appliqués aux secteurs de l'énergie, des infrastructures et des ressources naturelles. Vous renforcerez également votre compréhension des enjeux de transition énergétique et de financement de projets complexes au sein d'un environnement bancaire international.
 Grâce à votre exposition à des transactions stratégiques et à des interlocuteurs de haut niveau, vous développerez une vision globale des métiers du financement spécialisé et du conseil financier. Cette expérience constituera un véritable tremplin vers des fonctions d'analyste, d'associate ou de chargé d'affaires dans les domaines du financement de projet, du financement d'infrastructures, du crédit, des marchés de capitaux ou plus largement au sein des activités de banque de financement et d'investissement du Groupe. Comme pour de nombreuses missions VIE, des opportunités pourront être envisagées à l'issue de la mission en fonction des besoins et de la qualité de la collaboration.

About Alantra 
 Alantra is an independent global financial services firm that provides investment banking and asset management services to midmarket companies, families, and investors. The Group has over 500 professionals in Europe, the U.S., Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. 
 In Investment Banking, Alantra has completed over 1,000 transactions in the last five years. Alantra combines a strong local presence in key financial centers with global sector- and product-specialized teams. 
 In Alternative Asset Management, Alantra offers its clients unique access to a wide range of investment strategies in five highly specialized asset management classes (private equity, active funds, private debt, energy, and venture capital). As of 31 December 2025, assets under management from consolidated businesses stood at c. €2.7bn, while those managed by firms in which the Group holds a strategic stake amounted to c €14.5bn
 Job Description: 
 Job Description 
 Based in Frankfurt, you will work in a highly entrepreneurial and inspiring environment and become an integral part of our Investment Banking team, within Alantra’s Corporate Finance Team.
 The day-to-day tasks will include:
• Execution of active M&A mandates : Preparation of marketing materials, modeling and valuation analysis, data-room management, etc.
• Marketing initiatives: Market analyses of different industry verticals, preparation of market, strategic and industry peer analysis, screening of potential M&A targets/buyers, financial valuations, etc.
 Interns have direct exposure to all seniority levels internally, as well as direct client contact where possible. Alantra gives its Interns significant responsibilities and is committed to their learning experience during their tenure with the firm.
 If performance is outstanding, interns will have the chance to join our Corporate Finance team as analysts at the end of their internship.

• Applicants must have a strong interest in investment banking and M&A
• Strong academic background/results and financial knowledge (accounting and company valuation) and understanding of financial statements
• Entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to contribute your own ideas and work autonomously
• Proficiency in the use of Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook
• Capable of working under pressure and in a context of shifting priorities
• Impeccable communication and presentation skills (verbal and written)
• Attention to detail
• Proficiency (both written and spoken) in German and English is a requirement
 Application Details: 
• Start date: Q2 2027
• Duration: 3 months
• Location: Frankfurt, Germany

 Au quotidien ça donne quoi ? 
 Vous intégrerez l’équipe Financial Institutions Coverage EMEA, en charge de la relation avec les principaux acteurs du marché bancaire en France et au Luxembourg. Notre mission est de positionner BNP Paribas comme partenaire stratégique privilégié des institutions financières au travers de solutions traditionnelles ou innovantes et à forte valeur ajoutée. L'équipe s'appuie sur une expertise sectorielle partagée non seulement avec nos clients, mais aussi avec l'ensemble des métiers du Groupe BNP Paribas. Vous rejoindrez une équipe à taille humaine (une dizaine de collaborateurs).
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :
• La rédaction des memos internes à destination des Sponsors ou des équipes Risques
• L’analyse ESG des Groupes du portefeuille
• Le suivi des actualités du secteur et du portfolio clients
• L’interaction et coordination avec les différents métiers de la banque
• La coordination avec les équipes KYC et Compliance pour le suivi des donnés et démarches liées au portfolio client
 Vous contribuerez directement au développement commercial de la franchise sous la responsabilité des Seniors Bankers et travaillez avec le pool d'Associates par le biais :
• De votre suivi régulier de la connaissance et de l'animation de la relation client (activité, situation financière, enjeux industriels et stratégiques), 
• De votre dialogue régulier de bonne qualité avec l'ensemble des métiers et autres parties prenantes au sein du Groupe BNP Paribas,
• De votre appui aux équipes dédiées dans les processus Risques et Conformité,
• De votre implication dans l'origination de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.
 Nos tuteurs et tutrices se forment en continu pour mieux vous accompagner dans toutes les composantes de votre stage, toujours avec bienveillance. Une partie de leur temps de travail est d'ailleurs dédiée à votre encadrement : conseils de méthodes de travail, aide à la maîtrise du temps, développement d’une posture professionnelle... De quoi vous sentir bien dès votre arrivée ! 
 Ce stage basé dans le 9ème arrondissement de Paris et est à pourvoir à partir de Septembre 2026 pour une durée de 6 mois.
 Et après ? 
 Ce stage vous permettra non seulement de développer une compréhension approfondie du secteur bancaire Français et Luxembourgeois, des problématiques stratégiques et réglementaires mais aussi de découvrir l'ensemble des solutions offertes par BNP Paribas. Intégrer nos équipes vous permettra de développer un réseau dans l'ensemble des métiers du Groupe (Global Markets, M&A, ECM, DCM, Retail Banking). 
 D’autres opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous favorisant votre insertion professionnelle :
• Le Graduate Programme vous permet de booster votre avenir, de développer vos compétences et votre leadership grâce à des missions à responsabilité.
• Le Volontariat International en Entreprise vous donne l’opportunité d’enrichir votre parcours avec une expérience internationale unique de 12 à 24 mois 
 Les avantages à nous rejoindre : 
 Travailler au sein de BNP Paribas, c’est un package et des avantages :
• Une gratification mensuelle brute, supérieure au minimum prévu par la loi, variable selon le niveau d’études et le diplôme préparés, entre 1050 € et 1500 € brut par mois dans le cadre d’un bac+4 et entre 1250 € et 2100 € brut par mois dans le cadre d’un bac+5

 The Summer Analyst program offers an opportunity for college undergraduates interested in finance and corporate / investment banking to actively participate in this fast-paced and challenging industry.
